article.headline: Thursday night in Houston: one horse bolts, one hangs on, and the bottom stays [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]]'s
paras: Thursday night gave the race its first real shape, and Houston held the pen. Three teams had players in the game, and the other five spent the evening watching with a snack in hand.

[[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] won the night going away. [[p:5892|David Montgomery (RB, HOU, #32)]] carried 26 times for 107 yards and piled up six first downs, and BerkIam rolled to 16.9 points. The Chop% fell to 11, and the team climbed out of the sweat box for good, at least until Sunday.

The same stadium produced the night's best hope for [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFreeSince03]]. [[p:7569|Nico Collins (WR, HOU, #12)]] caught a touchdown and finished with 14.3 points, which is all ZynFree will have for a while. It was a fine night's work, but it did not move the favorite off the bottom. The Chop% sits at 46, the highest in the league, with five starters still waiting on Sunday and Monday.

[[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] drifted along on the other end of the prime-time lights. [[p:6813|Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND, #28)]] grinded out 5.2 points, enough to slip Kenny down to seventh place at 17%. The flight is cruising, not soaring.
[[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] was a bystander, still on a round zero with seven starters to go, and still comfortably in sixth at 15%. Nobody got hurt, and nobody went home with an excuse.

Now the race sleeps until Sunday's early games, when nearly every roster wakes at once. ZynFree's best swing is [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] on Monday night, projected for 22.7. Until then, the bottom belongs to the team that scored the second-most points on Thursday. Funny game.

articles.headline: Houston, we have a problem: [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] drops to last without leaving the pad
paras: I don't believe it. The hot seat changed owners while nobody was playing. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] has not scored a point or played a down, yet the projections reshuffled over the long wait and dropped him from sixth to dead last: a projected final of 91.8 and a Chop% that rocketed from 8 to 44. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]], Thursday's chair-warmer, slips out the side door with a Chop% cut from 36 to 17. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] sits between them at 22.

And now Sunday is finally moving. The international game is in its first quarter, and the only points so far belong to [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]]: [[p:11564|Drake Maye (QB, NE, #10)]] kept it for 11 yards and a first down, good for 1.6. The man has found the rink. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]], [[t:MVeny|MVeny]], [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]] and [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] all have a player on that field too, still waiting on a first point.

SkyWalker has nobody in it. All six of his starters are still on the pad: five go in the early games, and [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] waits for Sunday night. The projected gap up to BerkIam is 8.0 points. If that early five ignites, the seat goes back where it came from. If the countdown stalls, [[p:6770|Burrow]] flies the rescue mission alone.

articles.headline: [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] achieves liftoff without an engine; the hot seat lands on [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]]
paras: Unbelievable. He did it again, in reverse. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] still has not played a down, and the projections that buried him an hour ago have now dug him back out: his Chop% falls from 44 to 23 and he floats up off the bottom. The seat he left is warm, and [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] is sitting in it at 27, with a projected final of 99.8. The projected gap between them is 3.1 points. That is one catch.

The only real football is still overseas, Q2, 6:33, and it belongs to two teams nowhere near the trouble. [[p:7547|Amon-Ra St. Brown (WR, DET, #14)]] took two catches for 63 yards and a touchdown, 13.3 points that skate [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] up to fourth. [[p:9221|Jahmyr Gibbs (RB, DET, #0)]] ran for 76 yards and carried [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]] to the projected top of the board.

Now the early games load the cannon. BerkIam sends out [[p:4046|Patrick Mahomes (QB, KC, #15)]] and one receiver, with four starters held back for later. SkyWalker fires five at once. If that fleet flies, BerkIam needs [[p:4046|Mahomes]] to answer alone, or the seat stays put all afternoon.

articles.headline: [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] hits thin ice: fourth to eighth with a hole at quarterback
paras: Hold everything. An hour ago [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] skated up to fourth and I told you he was nowhere near the trouble. He is in it now. He drops to eighth, his Chop% leaps from 4 to 19, and the sheet lists his quarterback, [[p:11564|Drake Maye (QB, NE, #10)]], as out. His projected final is 102.0. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] still holds the hot seat at 23, projected 99.8, and has not moved a muscle. The gap is 2.2 points.

The cruel part: his one man overseas is brilliant. Q3, 9:02, and [[p:7547|Amon-Ra St. Brown (WR, DET, #14)]] has 98 yards and a second touchdown. It was not enough to hold the place. Meanwhile [[p:9221|Jahmyr Gibbs (RB, DET, #0)]] has gone feral, 107 yards rushing and 91 more receiving, 32.8 points, and [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]] is projected at 156.1 and eating everything in sight.

Now the early games open and the bottom is a traffic jam: four teams projected within 3.2 points. Hockey Guy sends four starters over the boards. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]], still at zero and drifting at 20, launches five. BerkIam answers with [[p:4046|Patrick Mahomes (QB, KC, #15)]] and one receiver. If [[p:4046|Mahomes]] stalls, the seat stays put. If the skaters stall, it gets a new owner.

articles.headline: Off the thin ice: [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] climbs to sixth and the hot seat stays with [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]]
paras: Scratch the obituary. An hour ago [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] was eighth and the ice was groaning. Now he is sixth, his Chop% eases from 19 to 16, and his projected final is 103.6. He did it without a quarterback and without a single new skater. The points from [[p:7547|Amon-Ra St. Brown (WR, DET, #14)]] finally landed in full: 23.8 on 98 yards and two touchdowns.

That shoves the trouble downhill. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] slips to eighth, still at zero, still on the launch pad. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] slides to seventh. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] has not moved a muscle in two chapters and holds the hot seat at 24, projected 99.8. Far above the smoke, [[p:9221|Jahmyr Gibbs (RB, DET, #0)]] is up to 45.2 points, 153 yards rushing and 99 more receiving, and [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]] is asking for the dessert menu.

Q4, 1:19 overseas, and then the early games open. The bottom is still a traffic jam: four teams projected within 3.8 points. Hockey Guy sends four over the boards. Kenny SkyWalker launches five at once. BerkIam answers with [[p:4046|Patrick Mahomes (QB, KC, #15)]] and one receiver. If [[p:4046|Mahomes]] gets going, the seat finds a new owner fast. If he stalls, BerkIam can start measuring the drapes.

articles.headline: Final whistle overseas: [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] keeps the hot seat, and the pack is breathing on it
paras: The overseas game is in the books, and the bell caught [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] exactly where the last chapter left him: on the hot seat, projected to be chopped, Chop% 24, projected final 100.1. He has 7.7 points and a long Sunday to find the rest.

The dessert went to [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]], fat and happy on 45.2 from [[p:9221|Jahmyr Gibbs (RB, DET, #0)]]. The scraps went nowhere. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] enjoyed sixth for one whole chapter, then slid back to seventh without a skate touching the ice, as [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] nudged past on projections alone. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] is eighth, still at 0.0, still fuelling on the launch pad.

Now the real traffic. Four teams are projected within 3.3 points of the axe, and the early games sort them. Kenny SkyWalker fires five engines at once. Hockey Guy sends four over the boards. BerkIam answers with [[p:4046|Patrick Mahomes (QB, KC, #15)]] and one receiver, then waits for the late shift. If [[p:4046|Mahomes]] stalls, the drapes get measured. If he flies, somebody else inherits the chair by lunch.

articles.headline: [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] inherits the hot seat: five engines lit, no liftoff
paras: Somebody did inherit the chair by lunch, and it was the one still on the launch pad. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] fired five engines at once and got smoke. The Chop% rocketed instead, from 21 to 55, and the ship is now last and projected to be chopped, projected final 81.6.

The drapes stay unmeasured at [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]]'s place. [[p:4046|Patrick Mahomes (QB, KC, #15)]] flew, found the end zone, and cut that Chop% from 24 to 13. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] sent four over the boards and they came back with 23.8 points, [[p:7594|Chuba Hubbard (RB, CAR, #30)]] leading the rush: seventh to fourth in one shift. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] got 15.2 from [[p:13337|Emmett Johnson (RB, KC, #10)]] and strolled clear too.

Not everyone escaped. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] tripped from fifth to eighth and is now the nearest neighbor, 14.2 projected points above the axe. That is the gap Kenny SkyWalker must close, and the countdown is not over: all five engines are still in the second quarter, one more starter flies in the late games, and [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] waits for Sunday night. If the boosters catch before halftime, the chair moves again. If not, it is a long, quiet orbit to nightfall.

articles.headline: Liftoff, sort of: [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] pulls within 4.4 of [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]]'s heel
paras: The boosters caught. Not a roar, more of a cough, but [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] left the pad with 17.5 points in an hour and the Chop% came down from 55 to 46. The ship is still last and still projected to be chopped. It is no longer alone up there.

Because the nearest neighbor is wobbling. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] managed 7.7 while everyone else ran, and its Chop% doubled, 14 to 29. [[p:4984|Josh Allen (QB, BUF, #17)]] has a rushing touchdown and not much else through the air, and one receiver is still looking for a first catch. The gap that stood at 14.2 projected points is now 4.4. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] saw all this and left the neighborhood, seventh to fifth, Chop% down to 6. [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] slid to seventh with 9.2 points and six starters still to come, which is less a crisis than a late alarm clock.

Now the third quarter, and it is a two-ship race. Kenny SkyWalker's five engines are all still burning, [[p:8112|Drake London (WR, ATL, #5)]] among them with 45 yards, and [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] waits for Sunday night. outsiderightfoot answers with a back in the late games and [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] parked until Monday night. One more touchdown from the launch pad and the hot seat changes hands before the early games end.

articles.headline: Three ships, 4.5 projected points: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] sleeps through the alarm and into the hot zone
paras: The launch pad got its hour. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] burned 30.9 points, [[p:8112|Drake London (WR, ATL, #5)]] climbed to 109 yards, and the Chop% came down to 41. The ship is still last and still projected to be chopped. But the hot seat did not change hands, because the neighbor woke up.

[[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] stopped wobbling. [[p:4984|Josh Allen (QB, BUF, #17)]] ran in a second touchdown and threw one too, the team put up 28.9, and it stepped up to seventh with its Chop% easing to 22. The one who slipped is [[t:MVeny|MVeny]]. That late alarm clock is still ringing: 7.5 points in the hour, 16.7 in all, down to eighth, Chop% up from 12 to 31. Meanwhile [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] kept leaving the neighborhood, fifth to second, and is now somebody else's story.

So the early games close with three ships in one patch of sky: projected finals of 91.5, 95.2 and 96.0. MVeny has the most fuel left, four starters still on the ground, [[p:6786|CeeDee Lamb (WR, DAL, #88)]] in Sunday's late games and two more waiting for Sunday night. Kenny SkyWalker has a back in the late games and [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] under the lights. If MVeny's late crew comes up 4 short of projected, the bottom has a new tenant by tonight.

articles.headline: New tenant in the basement: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] hits snooze and inherits the hot seat
paras: The last chapter promised the bottom a new tenant by tonight. It did not take that long. [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] found 3.2 points in the hour, slid to last, and watched its Chop% leap from 31 to 53. The alarm clock is still ringing. Now it is ringing in the basement. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] climbed to eighth mostly by standing still: 2.0 points, Chop% parked at 40.

The turn came from the third ship, which simply left. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] added 11.1, [[p:9753|Zach Charbonnet (RB, SEA, #26)]] got rolling in the late games, and the Chop% fell from 22 to 5. That patch of sky now holds two: projected finals of 83.4 for MVeny and 85.6 for the SkyWalker, with 36.7 real points between them on the board.

But MVeny still has all the fuel. Four starters to come: [[p:8150|Kyren Williams (RB, LAR, #23)]] is on 3.2 in the second quarter, [[p:6786|CeeDee Lamb (WR, DAL, #88)]] is still waiting on a first catch, and two more go Sunday night. Kenny SkyWalker has one back in the late games and [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] under the lights. If MVeny's four beat their projection by a little over 2 points, the hot seat changes hands again. Somebody wake that crew up.

articles.headline: Somebody did not wake that crew up: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] sleeps through another hour
paras: The last chapter ended with a plea to wake the crew. Nobody did. [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] found 0.4 points in the hour and its Chop% jumped from 53 to 78. The strange part: [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] scored nothing at all, hovered in eighth, and watched its own Chop% fall from 40 to 21. A ship with the engines off is somehow pulling away.

The turn is the fuel that would not light. [[p:6786|CeeDee Lamb (WR, DAL, #88)]] reached halftime with four targets and no catches. [[p:8150|Kyren Williams (RB, LAR, #23)]] is on 3.6 in the third quarter. So the projected finals drifted apart: 71.6 for MVeny, 82.6 for the SkyWalker. Meanwhile [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] is nearly out of sight at a Chop% of 1.

MVeny still holds the most tickets. Lamb and Williams have a half to play, and [[p:96|Aaron Rodgers (QB, PIT, #8)]] leads two more starters out Sunday night. Kenny SkyWalker answers with [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] under the same lights. MVeny's four must beat their projection by about 11 points to hand the hot seat back. The alarm is still ringing. Does anyone in that basement own a second half?

articles.headline: The basement stirs, yawns, rolls over: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] wakes up and sinks anyway
paras: Somebody finally found the light switch. [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] scored 4.9 points this hour, a stampede by basement standards. The reward? Its Chop% climbed from 78 to 90. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] added a single point, engines still off, and saw its own Chop% halve from 21 to 10. That ship is coasting on pure gravity, and gravity is winning.

The turn is that the second half showed up small. [[p:6786|CeeDee Lamb (WR, DAL, #88)]] at last caught something: two balls on eight targets, 3.8 points, with a quarter still to play. It was not enough to move the math. The projected finals now read 65.1 for MVeny and 80.1 for the SkyWalker, and the gap between them grew again.

So it all goes to Sunday night. MVeny sends out [[p:96|Aaron Rodgers (QB, PIT, #8)]] and [[p:8228|Jaylen Warren (RB, PIT, #30)]], plus whatever Lamb has left. Kenny SkyWalker answers with [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]], alone on the bridge. MVeny's three must beat their projection by about 15 points to hand the hot seat back. The alarm has stopped ringing. Is that because someone got up, or because the battery died?

articles.headline: The battery wasn't dead: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] gets up, and [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] feels the heat
paras: Somebody got up. [[p:6786|CeeDee Lamb (WR, DAL, #88)]] spent three quarters as a rumor, then caught fire in the fourth: 14.4 points in one last burst, a touchdown included. At the bell of Sunday's late games, [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] sits on 39.6, still last, still projected to be chopped. But its Chop% fell from 90 to 61, and the basement suddenly has a window.

The cold draft blows straight at [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]]. The ship did not score a point all session, engines still off, and its Chop% jumped from 10 to 38 while it sat there. The lead is 18.0 on the board. The projected finals say 80.1 to 76.9. Gravity has company now.

Sunday night settles it, and both sides fly in the same game. MVeny sends [[p:96|Aaron Rodgers (QB, PIT, #8)]] and [[p:8228|Jaylen Warren (RB, PIT, #30)]], two arrows for an 18-point hole. Kenny SkyWalker answers with [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]], alone on the bridge and now very much awake. Everyone else is projected clear. One of these two is projected for the block, and neither has anyone left for Monday. The alarm is ringing again. This time it is on the ship.

articles.headline: Engines on: [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] lifts off, and the window slams on [[t:MVeny|MVeny]]
paras: The alarm on the ship worked. [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] woke up on the bridge and flew a spotless first quarter: 14 of 17 passing, 5.7 points, no turbulence. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] pulled the lead out from 18.0 to 23.4, and its Chop% dropped from 38 to 6. Gravity has been told to wait outside.

The window in the basement is closing fast. [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] sent two arrows and so far has hit the wall with both. [[p:96|Aaron Rodgers (QB, PIT, #8)]] is 0 for 2 with nothing on the board. [[p:8228|Jaylen Warren (RB, PIT, #30)]] has one carry and 0.3 points. In an hour MVeny's Chop% went from 61 to 94, and the projected finals now read 80.2 to 64.5.

But it is only Q2, 15:00, and all three are still on the field. Rodgers and Warren are projected for about 25 more between them, and the hole is 23.4. They need all of that and then some, while Burrow needs only to keep the engines humming. Neither side has anyone left for Monday. Three quarters to find out whether the battery has one more spark, or whether MVeny is projected for the block.

articles.headline: Halftime: [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] hits orbit, and [[t:MVeny|MVeny]]'s battery reads 100% doomed
paras: Forget humming engines. [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] found the hyperdrive: 302 yards and 3 touchdowns by halftime, 19.2 points in a single hour. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] is not just clear of the basement, it has flown past [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] into seventh. Its Chop% is 0. Gravity went home.

Down in the basement, the two arrows are still in the wall. [[p:96|Aaron Rodgers (QB, PIT, #8)]] is 4 of 12 for 25 yards and 0.9 points. [[p:8228|Jaylen Warren (RB, PIT, #30)]] has scraped together 3.5. [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] sits on 44.0, and the nearest team is 32.5 ahead. The Chop% went from 94 to 100, which is the number where the caller stops doing math.

And yet there is a half to play. Rodgers and Warren are projected for about 15 more between them, so MVeny needs double that and a little magic, with nobody left for Monday. The new neighbor, outsiderightfoot, still has [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] waiting for Monday night, so that target only moves away. Two quarters for the spark of the season, or MVeny is projected for the block.

articles.headline: Fourth quarter: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] finally strikes a spark, and the wall is still 22.3 high
paras: The spark came. [[p:96|Aaron Rodgers (QB, PIT, #8)]] found the end zone and 8.2 points in an hour, and [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] climbed 10.2 to reach 54.2. The Chop% did not even blink. It is still 100. The caller put the calculator away at halftime, and it is staying in the drawer.

Here is why. The nearest team, [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]], sits 22.3 ahead without playing a snap tonight. Rodgers and [[p:8228|Jaylen Warren (RB, PIT, #30)]] are projected for about 5 more between them. Meanwhile [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] is still in orbit and sending postcards: [[p:6770|Joe Burrow (QB, CIN, #9)]] is up to 408 yards and 4 touchdowns, a 33.1-point flight.

So it comes down to this, with 10:53 left in the fourth: MVeny needs four times what the projections offer, and has nobody for Monday. outsiderightfoot does. [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] waits for Monday night, so the wall only gets taller. One quarter for a miracle, or MVeny is projected for the block.

articles.headline: Sunday wrap: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] climbs the wall, runs out of ladder 13.8 short
paras: The miracle quarter came and went. [[p:96|Aaron Rodgers (QB, PIT, #8)]] threw a second touchdown and finished with 15.0, and [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] scraped together 8.5 more to close Sunday at 62.7. The wall that stood 22.3 high is down to 13.8. It is still a wall. The calculator never left the drawer: the Chop% is 100, and MVeny has nobody left to play.

Up front, it was a different sport. [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]] ate everything on the table, 180.1 in a single day, with [[p:9221|Jahmyr Gibbs (RB, DET, #0)]] serving 45.2 of it on 252 yards and 2 touchdowns. [[t:bmransom|bmransom]] collected 137.2 and sits second. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] and [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] both cleared 100 and skated off safe, the Hockey Guy still not quite sure what a first down is.

The quiet day belonged to [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]], and it hardly mattered. [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]] put up 46.3 by himself, 3 touchdowns and 223 yards, which was most of the congregation's Sunday offering. And [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] has landed: 90.8, wheels down, done for the week and well clear of the block.

The trainers were busy. Hockey Guy had two starters hurt, and both are now listed Out. Torn-Again Christian lost a receiver the same way, also listed Out. BerkIam's tight end was hurt, came back into the game, and is listed Out tonight. bmransom's tight end was hurt, returned, and is listed Questionable.

Monday night holds three loose ends, all in the same game. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]], sitting on 76.5, still has [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]], projected for 18.9. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] and Torn-Again Christian each have one starter to come as well. None of it reaches the bottom. outsiderightfoot is already ahead without Henry touching the ball, so Monday can only make the wall taller.
Which leaves MVeny at the foot of it, ladder spent, projected for the chopping block. The axe does not fall until the last whistle Monday. The caller suggests using the time to pack.

articles.headline: Monday kickoff: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] finds 0.6 in the couch, wall still stands 13.2 high
paras: The caller told [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] to pack. MVeny went through the couch cushions instead and came up with 0.6 overnight, good for 63.3. The wall that stood 13.8 high is now 13.2. It is still a wall, the ladder is still spent, and the Chop% is still 100 with nobody left to play.

Now the ball is in the air on Monday night, and all three loose ends are tied to the same game. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]], the nearest roof above the block at 76.5, sends out [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]], projected for 18.5. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] has [[p:5012|Mark Andrews (TE, BAL, #89)]], and [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] passes the plate to [[p:9997|Zay Flowers (WR, BAL, #4)]]. All three sit at zero, first quarter, clock full.

Here is the cruel part: none of them can help. outsiderightfoot is already clear without Henry touching the ball, so every yard tonight only adds bricks. MVeny would need the scoreboard to run backward. The only race left is upstairs, where Torn-Again Christian is projected to finish at 134.5 and ZynFree at 122.3, both chasing nothing but pride. The axe waits for the last whistle. Is the suitcase zipped yet?

articles.headline: Minus one yard, one touchdown: Henry does magic while [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] zips the suitcase
paras: The suitcase is zipped. [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] sits at 63.3 with nobody left to play, the Chop% still reads 100, and the couch has no cushions left to search. Everything moving tonight is upstairs.

[[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] carried five times for minus one yard and still found the end zone. That is a magic trick, not a stat line, and it is worth 6.6 to [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]], now at 83.1. Higher up, [[p:5012|Mark Andrews (TE, BAL, #89)]] caught three balls for 33 yards and lifted [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] to 121.4, one point ahead of [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] for the moment.

Halftime is 31 seconds away. Henry is projected for 15.4, and 7.7 more would carry outsiderightfoot past [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]], parked at 90.8 with the engines off. Meanwhile [[p:9997|Zay Flowers (WR, BAL, #4)]] has one catch for 2.7 and owes the church crowd a second-half sermon: Torn-Again Christian is projected to retake the pew at 127.5. Can a man running backward pass a spaceship?

articles.headline: Henry climbs all the way back to zero yards as [[t:Dgt999|SkyWalker]] watches the mirror
paras: Breaking news from the basement: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] is still at 63.3, still out of players, still at 100 Chop%. The suitcase stays zipped. The real race tonight is the tug-of-war upstairs.

[[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] has rallied from minus one yard to a full zero on six carries. Progress! His touchdown still holds the act together, and [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] sits at 83.2, 7.6 behind [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]], who is parked at 90.8 with nothing left to play. Higher up, [[p:5012|Mark Andrews (TE, BAL, #89)]] now has five catches for 45 yards, and [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] has stretched its lead over [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] to 2.3. The projections flipped too: last chapter's predicted comeback for the church crowd is now projected to fall half a point short.

Q3, 7:46, and every Baltimore snap is a vote. Henry is projected to finish at 12.8, which leaves outsiderightfoot projected at 89.3, just shy of the spaceship. He needs one more burst, a real one, with positive yards. And [[p:9997|Zay Flowers (WR, BAL, #4)]] still has one catch for 2.7. The sermon has not started. Will the congregation get one before the fourth quarter?

articles.headline: Henry finds the end zone again and [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] blasts past the spaceship
paras: Last chapter asked for one more burst. [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] delivered a second touchdown, and his rushing total has soared all the way to 10 yards. [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] jumped 9.8 points to 93.0 and leapfrogged [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]], now stuck in eighth at 90.8 with an empty cockpit. Down in the basement, [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] still sits at 63.3 and 100 Chop%. The suitcase never unzipped.

Upstairs, the sermon finally started. [[p:9997|Zay Flowers (WR, BAL, #4)]] went from one catch to six for 74 yards, with one fumble lost in the collection plate, and lifted [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] to 127.6. But [[p:5012|Mark Andrews (TE, BAL, #89)]] kept answering, eight catches for 82 yards, and [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] stretched the gap to 2.7 at 130.3.

Q4, 1:48 in Baltimore. Henry, Flowers and Andrews are the last three starters on the field in our league. The church crowd is projected to finish at 128.0, 2.6 short of ZynFree. Flowers needs one big final-drive grab to rewrite the hymnal. Can he find it before the clock runs dry?

articles.headline: The bell tolls in Baltimore, and [[t:MVeny|MVeny]] takes the long walk to the block
paras: The final whistle blew in Baltimore, and nothing moved. Every starter in our league is done. Week 10 is in the books, and the axe has its name: [[t:MVeny|MVeny]], at 63.3 and 100 Chop%. They picked up 0.6 points tonight. The suitcase got unzipped after all, just long enough to pack.

Monday belonged to the Ravens. [[p:3198|Derrick Henry (RB, BAL, #22)]] scored twice on 10 carries for 10 yards, a stat line only a goal-line bulldozer could love. His 16.5 points carried [[t:outsiderightfoot|outsiderightfoot]] past [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] and into seventh at 93.0. The spaceship ends the week in eighth at 90.8, still parked on the launch pad, but parked safely.

Upstairs, the hymnal stayed as written. Last chapter asked whether the church crowd's final-drive prayer would land. It did not. [[p:5012|Mark Andrews (TE, BAL, #89)]] closed with eight catches for 82 yards and 14.7 points, and [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] holds third at 130.3, 2.7 clear of [[t:MayebachMusic10|Torn-Again Christian]] at 127.6. The congregation can take comfort in [[p:4034|Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF, #23)]], whose 46.3 points led every starter in the league this week.

At the top, [[t:nomnomnomnomnom|nomnomnomnomnom]] finished at 180.1, nearly 38 points clear of [[t:bmransom|bmransom]]. Somewhere in the middle, [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] skated to sixth at 103.2, still not entirely sure which sport this is, but sure enough to stay out of the basement.

And so we say goodbye to [[t:MVeny|MVeny]]. They fought, they watched, they hoped for a Monday miracle that never boarded the bus. The block is cold, the blade is sharp, and the roster heads to the waiver wire. Nine became eight. Tuesday morning, the clock resets, and somebody new starts sweating.

articles.headline: Eight left, one axe: [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] opens Week 11 at 46% to get chopped
paras: Eight teams left, one axe, and the gates just opened in Houston. Thursday's game sits at Q1 15:00, so every team is on a big round zero. The odds already have a favorite to go home, though: [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFreeSince03]] carries a 46% Chop%, projected for 97.3, the only team projected under 100.

The trouble started before the whistle. [[p:12512|Quinshon Judkins (RB, CLE, #10)]] sits in ZynFree's Out column, so that stable runs a horse short. Next in the danger lane is [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]], projected for 109.0 at 18%, a long way from home ice and waiting on all seven starters until Sunday.

Tonight's race card: [[p:7569|Nico Collins (WR, HOU, #12)]] can start ZynFree's comeback, [[p:5892|David Montgomery (RB, HOU, #32)]] rides for [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] at 16%, and [[p:6813|Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND, #28)]] lights the first engine for [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker ✨🪐🛩️]]. Watch [[p:7569|Collins]]: a big night and ZynFree's odds start to slide. A quiet one, and the axe gets sharpened for Sunday.

articles.headline: Touchdown Houston: [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] sinks from 46% to 28% Chop%
paras: The favorite just stumbled out of the danger lane. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFreeSince03]] has 12.3 points, nearly all of it from [[p:7569|Nico Collins (WR, HOU, #12)]], who found the end zone in Q2 and cut the Chop% to 28. The horse short in the stable is still short, but this one is galloping.

The pressure slid down the track. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] climbed to 23% with just 4.1 points from [[p:5892|David Montgomery (RB, HOU, #32)]], and now sits right behind ZynFree in the sweat box. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] sits sixth at 21%, projected for 109.0, still on a big round zero and waiting on seven starters. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] has barely left the pad: [[p:6813|Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND, #28)]] has 2.3 points and the odds sit at 14%.

Houston still has Q2 left, so nothing is settled. After tonight, the race goes quiet until Sunday's early games, when almost every roster wakes up at once. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] still has [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] to come Monday night. If he delivers, the comeback is real. If not, the axe stays sharp.

articles.headline: Mirage over Houston: [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] snaps back to 39% Chop%
paras: The comeback lasted about an hour. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFreeSince03]] is still stuck on 12.3 points, because [[p:7569|Nico Collins (WR, HOU, #12)]] stopped scoring while the rest of the field kept moving. The Chop% jumped 11 points to 39, and the favorite is back in the bottom spot.

Blame the other Houston horse. [[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] got 7.1 points from [[p:5892|David Montgomery (RB, HOU, #32)]] and bolted from 23% to 14%, climbing out of the sweat box. [[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] is idling on 3.3 points, with [[p:6813|Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND, #28)]] still grinding in Q3, and sits at 16%. [[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] is on a big round zero at 18%, waiting on seven starters.

Nothing is settled. The race sleeps until Sunday's early games, when almost every roster wakes at once. [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]] still has [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] on Monday night, projected for 22.7. If he delivers, the mirage turns real. If not, the axe stays sharp.

articles.headline: Thursday night in Houston: one horse bolts, one hangs on, and the bottom stays [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFree]]'s
paras: Thursday night gave the race its first real shape, and Houston held the pen. Three teams had players in the game, and the other five spent the evening watching with a snack in hand.

[[t:BerkIam|BerkIam]] won the night going away. [[p:5892|David Montgomery (RB, HOU, #32)]] carried 26 times for 107 yards and piled up six first downs, and BerkIam rolled to 16.9 points. The Chop% fell to 11, and the team climbed out of the sweat box for good, at least until Sunday.

The same stadium produced the night's best hope for [[t:ZynFreeSince03|ZynFreeSince03]]. [[p:7569|Nico Collins (WR, HOU, #12)]] caught a touchdown and finished with 14.3 points, which is all ZynFree will have for a while. It was a fine night's work, but it did not move the favorite off the bottom. The Chop% sits at 46, the highest in the league, with five starters still waiting on Sunday and Monday.

[[t:Dgt999|Kenny SkyWalker]] drifted along on the other end of the prime-time lights. [[p:6813|Jonathan Taylor (RB, IND, #28)]] grinded out 5.2 points, enough to slip Kenny down to seventh place at 17%. The flight is cruising, not soaring.
[[t:rafoster2124|Hockey Guy]] was a bystander, still on a round zero with seven starters to go, and still comfortably in sixth at 15%. Nobody got hurt, and nobody went home with an excuse.

Now the race sleeps until Sunday's early games, when nearly every roster wakes at once. ZynFree's best swing is [[p:11566|Jayden Daniels (QB, WAS, #5)]] on Monday night, projected for 22.7. Until then, the bottom belongs to the team that scored the second-most points on Thursday. Funny game.
